items.title: 25.2 Kuch compounds ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of retrosynthesis examples (PDF 137-139).

items: Disconnection: ester ka C-O bond torne se synthon A, acylium ion CH3CO+, aur synthon B, ethoxide ion C2H5O-, milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents: CH3CO+ ethanoic (acetic) acid aur C2H5O- ethanol faraham karta hai.
Synthesis: esterification, CH3COOH + C2H5OH -> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O (garha H2SO4).

blocks.alt: Step I: ethyl acetate, C=O wale carbon aur ester oxygen ke bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (A) aur ethoxide ion -O-C2H5 synthon (B). Step II: synthon (A) acetic acid (SE) aur synthon (B) ethanol (SE) ke barabar. Synthesis: CH3-COOH + C2H5-OH, H2SO4 ke saath, se CH3-CO-O-C2H5 + H2O.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.1: ethyl acetate ka retrosynthetic tree aur synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 137-138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ko oopar se neeche parhein: Step I mein ester ka C-O bond kaata gaya (laal nishan), jis se acylium ion (A) aur ethoxide ion (B) bane. Step II mein teen lakeeron wala nishan batata hai ke in ki jagah asal mein kaun se reagents (SE) istemal honge: acetic acid aur ethanol. Aakhri satar asal synthesis hai: H2SO4 ki maujoodgi mein esterification.

items: FGI: amino group nitro group mein badla jata hai, kyunke nitro group electrophilic substitution se benzene par aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi lag sakta.
Disconnection: nitrobenzene ka C-N bond torne se aryl anion C6H5- aur nitronium ion NO2+ milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents aur synthesis: benzene aur nitric acid; benzene ki nitration (HNO3, H2SO4), phir nitrobenzene ko Sn aur HCl se reduce karein.

blocks.alt: Step I: aniline (NH2 wala benzene) aur khula teer 'FGI' nitrobenzene tak. Step II: nitrobenzene ke C-N bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir manfi charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur musbat charge wala NO2 synthon (B). Step III: benzene (H dikhaya gaya), teer ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4, se nitrobenzene, phir Sn + HCl se aniline.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.2: aniline ka retrosynthetic tree (kitab ke PDF safha 138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Disconnection: ring aur C=O group ke darmiyan C-C bond torne se aryl anion C6H5- aur acylium cation CH3CO+ milte hain.
Synthetic equivalents: benzene aur ethanoyl (acyl) chloride.
Synthesis: Friedel-Crafts acylation, C6H6 + CH3COCl -> C6H5COCH3 + HCl (AlCl3 catalyst).

blocks.alt: Step I: acetophenone (C(=O)CH3 wala benzene), ring aur carbon ke bond par lehredaar katt, 'Disconnection' teer, phir manfi charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur acylium ion H3C-C(=O)+ synthon (B). Step II: synthon (A) benzene (SE) aur synthon (B) acyl chloride H3C-CO-Cl (SE) ke barabar. Synthesis: benzene + acyl chloride, AlCl3 ke saath, se acetophenone + HCl.
blocks.caption: Misal 25.2.3: acetophenone ka retrosynthetic tree aur synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 138 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Cholesterol ki tareekhi synthesis pehli baar 1950 ki dahai ke shuru mein do muqabil groups ne ki, jin ki qayadat Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur Harvard mein R. B. Woodward kar rahe the.

blocks.prompt: Aniline ki synthesis mein benzene ki nitration kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Amino group seedha benzene par nahi lag sakta, lekin nitro group electrophilic substitution se lag sakta hai; phir nitro group NH2 mein reduce hota hai (FGI).

blocks.prompt: Phenyl ethanoate, CH3COOC6H5, dawaiyan banane mein use hota hai. Is ka retrosynthetic tree, synthetic equivalents aur synthesis batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ester ka C-O bond torein: CH3COOC6H5 => CH3CO+ + C6H5O-. Synthetic equivalents: CH3CO+ ke liye ethanoyl chloride (CH3COCl), aur C6H5O- ke liye phenol (C6H5OH). Synthesis: CH3COCl + C6H5OH -> CH3COOC6H5 + HCl, NaOH jaise base ke saath garam kar ke (phenol khud ethanoic acid se achhi tarah ester nahi banata).

items: Ethyl ethanoate: C-O disconnection; tezaab + alcohol.
Aniline: FGI se nitrobenzene; nitration phir reduction.
